description: The 0-100 trust score of a marketplace listing (by its id from search_marketplace or find_tool) or of a seller (by seller.id), with every input shown: paid use in the x402 directory and through AIPayGen, uptime, delivery in our weekly paid test purchases, and verified reviews. Concentrated paid use is not counted, and the answer says so. Free.

id.description: Listing id as kind:id, e.g. api:x402-14342d806afbda09

seller.description: A seller.id from search results (16 hex)

name: get_trust
title: Trust score of a listing or seller
